# The river and its banks (generated by make_env.py), y = -6.6.
new
material new Water --base-color 0.388 0.471 0.490 --no-slot
material new Bank --base-color 0.792 0.627 0.353 --no-slot
add mesh plane --name River --size 1 --location 0 0 -6.6
scale 9.6 30 1
apply --scale
material assign Water
add mesh plane --name BankL --size 1 --location -5.20 0 -6.55
scale 2.0 30 1
apply --scale
material assign Bank
add mesh plane --name BankR --size 1 --location 5.20 0 -6.55
scale 2.0 30 1
apply --scale
material assign Bank
select all
shade flat
export river.glb
